thread:
Lena: quick quarterly pattern review — I ran a recurrence scan for Jan-Mar and surfaced 5 repeating vectors. posting counts + suggested owners. trying to get these into tracked tickets this week.

OpsBot: Incident clustering complete: 31 incidents identified over 90 days. Clusters: node-pool-saturation, deploy-label-errors, warmup-misses, external-auth-failures, background-job-thundering. Report: https://infra/reports/recurrence-q1-2026

Kofi: can you paste the counts?

Lena: counts: node-pool-saturation: 10, deploy-label-errors: 7, warmup-misses: 6, external-auth-failures: 5, thundering-jobs: 3.

Iris: I'll take warmup-misses. we've seen tail latency blow up on model swaps. plan: implement pre-warm hook + gauge-based warmup trigger. ETA 3w.

Sam: tagging infra: node-pool-saturation looks like our biggest contributor to page storms. I can own mitigation: short-term bump pool-margin at model-swap windows; long-term revise autoscaler smoothing window.

Vik: deploy-label-errors — I'll own. Root cause seems to be a templating bug in our deploy pipeline that omits pool tags for some services. Plan: linter + e2e check in CI. ETA: 2w.

Lena: proposed action items (I'll open tickets and assign provisional owners):
```
- ACTION-RPT-101: Node pool margin & autoscaler smoothing. Owner: Sam. ETA: 2026-04-12. Deliverables: policy change, load test, alert tuning.
- ACTION-RPT-102: Deploy pipeline linter + post-deploy verifier. Owner: Vik. ETA: 2026-03-30. Deliverables: linter, CI gate, runbook.
- ACTION-RPT-103: Warmup hook + gauge trigger. Owner: Iris. ETA: 2026-04-22. Deliverables: warmup lib, benchmark, rollout steps.
- ACTION-RPT-104: External auth retry + circuit-breaker. Owner: Kofi. ETA: 2026-03-28. Deliverables: retry middleware, metrics, product sign-off.
- ACTION-RPT-105: Background job scheduler jitter + DB-connection alerts. Owner: Lena. ETA: 2026-04-05. Deliverables: scheduler config, alert rule, migration docs.
```

Kofi: for ACTION-RPT-104, need product to sign off on retry budget. @Vik can you help with telemetry hooks so product can see user-impact before approve?

Vik: yes — I'll add a telemetry dashboard tile for success-rate vs user-facing errors.

Sam: putting a draft alert rule for pool saturation here: 
expr: sum(node_allocated_cpu) / sum(node_capacity_cpu) > 0.9
for: 8m
labels: severity=page
annotations: summary="High cluster CPU allocation - possible pool exhaustion"

Iris: small data point — our warmup approach should avoid double-allocating GPUs during warmup. I'll add a safety flag to the implementation.

Lena: I'll create the tickets ENG-3101..ENG-3105 and add the action items + recurrence note ("why this kept recurring") to each. Will link tickets here when done.

OpsBot: Reminder: Open ACTION items without confirmed owners after 48h will be assigned to oncall.

Vik: question — can we standardize the "recurrence reason" field in tickets? suggests options like: config-drift, capacity-surge, pipeline-bug, external-flaky.

Lena: yes — good idea. I'll include that enum in ticket template.

Kofi: approved a 24h low-traffic window for external auth integration tests. posting calendar invite.

Sam: starting a load-test for the autoscaler tweak tomorrow; will post results here.

Vik: I'll start the linter PR tonight and aim for review by mid-week.

Iris: will run an initial warmup benchmark today and post numbers.

Lena: thanks all. scheduling a 25m follow-up on Thu to review PRs and blockers. calendar invite to follow.

Sam: :rocket:
